sources.title: Carlson, Lutz and Schaepe, Turning the Page: Ethnohistory from a New Generation (2009), UFV Research Review 2(2), pp. 1–8.

verification.note: Read indexed primary text, pp. 1–5 and 7–8: disciplinary resources, 1997 planning, named staff and community research priorities. Live download returned 404. Biography dates conflict internally (1997/1998); do not use them as a single founding date. Later model descriptions are retrospective, not proof of every detail in the first class.

sources.title: UVic, Ethnohistory Field School with the Stó:lō, institutional programme history.

verification.note: Read welcome section: first field school in 1998 and community-selected projects. Present partnership is not assigned wholesale to 1998. Saskatchewan participation dates differ across institutional accounts (2002/2003); not canonicalized here.

sources.title: UVic Ring, Naxaxalhts’i (Albert “Sonny” McHalsie), honorary-degree profile, June 2011, p. 6 (PDF page 6).

verification.note: Read McHalsie profile: teaching and mentoring in the field school since 1998. Later institutional recognition does not date the origin of his knowledge or community traditions.

verification.note: Read programme account and McHalsie’s statements on place-name teaching. Contemporary descriptions support later practice; first-course date is separately corroborated.

sources.title: Richard White, Introduction, The Middle Ground (1991), pp. ix–xvi, Cambridge University Press.

verification.note: Indexed primary introduction excerpt and print metadata checked. Cultural interaction is more complex than an absorption/resistance dichotomy. Regional scope is Great Lakes, 1650–1815. Online date 2012 is not the original publication date; full book and direct transmission to other scholars unchecked.

Existing 2002 Making Native Space record and qualification preserved.
